entries: manifest.json plus data/000000.json onward; UTF-8 strict JSON only
identity: archive-local revision identifiers; original private-dependent IDs omitted; public source/model/entity identities preserved
import: immutable historical collection; same projection is idempotent; distinct projections coexist; no overwrite or automatic execution
privacy: keys and encrypted key blobs never read; optional private categories excluded by default; active private payloads only, no indexes/backups
evidence: ordinary retains all public physical findings, observations and traces; reduced enumerates each omitted revision/boundary; private annotations and references redacted in all snapshots
